transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

My wife wanted me to come. I’ve been… hearing things in the house. Like water running, or men whispering in the walls, but when I check there’s nobody there. Sometimes I think I see a wet, dark patch spreading in the hallway, but it’s dry. It scared her. Scared me too, I guess.
How long have you been experiencing these hearing and seeing things that aren't there?
About seven months, I think. Since that winter freeze… the repairs on the house turned into a whole mess, and it just kind of started around then.
Do these voices or sounds you hear seem to have any relation to your mood or how you're feeling at the time?

Yeah… I think so. It wasn’t happening before I got so low. Before the house stuff dragged on, I wasn’t hearing things in the walls or seeing those spots.

It started after I’d already kind of… stopped caring about things. Felt like I’d failed, every day. Then the other stuff showed up.
Did you feel low and stop caring about things before you started hearing the voices and seeing things that aren't there, or did they happen at the same time?
The low part came first. I’d already stopped caring about… normal things, and I felt like I was failing every day. The voices and seeing things, that came after. I didn’t have that before.
How would you describe the intensity of your feelings of failing every day and not caring about things?
It’s… pretty heavy. Most days I wake up already feeling like I’ve failed as a husband, as a man. And it just kind of sits there on me all day, until I go to bed.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really. I used to be the guy who’d show up for soccer, mess around brewing beer in the garage, help out at the fire department… stuff like that.

Now it just feels pointless. I can’t really make myself care enough to go.
Did the voices and visions stop when you felt slightly better, or have they continued even on days when your low mood wasn't as bad?

They didn’t really stop just because I had a slightly better day.

I mean… before all this with the house dragging on, before I got this low, I wasn’t hearing things in the walls or seeing wet spots that weren’t there. I wasn’t thinking the neighbors were watching me like that.

That all came after I’d already stopped caring about my normal life and was feeling like a failure most days.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past seven months?
Yeah… I think so. I haven’t been trying to. Food just doesn’t taste like much anymore, kind of like cardboard, so I skip meals without really noticing. My jeans are loose now.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely happy, energetic, or irritable, and you weren't able to sleep because you felt like you had so much energy?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had good moods before, like anybody, but not where I was full of energy and didn’t need sleep or anything like that.
Have you ever had a time in your life when you felt extremely happy or energetic for several days or longer?
No… I don’t think I’ve had anything like that for several days. Not that I can remember.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely happy or energetic for at least several days?
No… I already said, I don’t really remember anything like that. Not for days at a time.
Have you ever felt extremely energetic or irritable for more than a few days at any point in your life before these past seven months?
No… before this, I don’t remember any stretch like that. Not more than a few days.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely irritable for several days or longer?
Not really… I mean, I get irritated like anyone, but not for several days like that.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely happy or energetic and your friends or family noticed a change in you?
No… I don’t think so. Nobody ever told me I was acting that way, at least not that I remember.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely happy or energetic for at least four consecutive days?
No… I don’t think I’ve had anything like that for four days straight.
Have you ever felt extremely happy for more than a few days at any point in your life?
No… I don’t think so. Not more than a few days.
Have you ever felt extremely happy for a week or longer at any point in your life?
No… not for a whole week. I don’t remember anything like that.
Have you ever had a time when your mood changed from very low to very high or vice versa within a short period?
I don’t think so… not like swinging up really high. I mostly just know when I’m low.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt extremely high or energetic and did things that were unusual for you?
No… I don’t think I’ve had something like that. I mean, I’ve had times I felt a little better, but not extremely high or doing unusual things.
Did you ever notice a time when you felt better than usual for a while, and then went back to feeling low again?
I don’t really know. Maybe I’ve had moments where things felt a little less bad, but I wouldn’t say it lasted or turned into feeling good. I just… usually end up low again.
